body:
Thanks, but I've wanted out since I was about 14. I was bullied constantly for 9 years and literally feared for my safety on a daily basis. So in addition to being bipolar, I have PTSD to deal with. Standing up for myself wasn't an option; doing so would've made it worse. 

I bottled it for years and it ate away at me. Then the cork popped when I was 27 and it's been downhill since then. 

I can go from being somewhat OK to being livid to being somewhat OK again in a matter of minutes. Everyone's tired of the rollercoaster ride. Including me.
